name: Shaitan Tactics (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains

disable: DC 20 Arcana check (trained) or DC 20 Nature check (trained) to contest the shaitan's control (requires two successes).
reset: The trap deactivates and resets once all hostile creatures leave A3 or surrender.
routine: (2 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the trap either moves a willing creature on the ground up to 30 feet without provoking reactions or makes a hostile creature on the ground Off-Guard for 1 round on a failed DC 20 Acrobatics check check or DC 20 Reflex save save.

items.name: Opening Move
items.text:
Trigger The shaitan sees a non-genie creature threatening an ally

---

Effect The trap rolls initiative and the shaitan takes control of the floor in A3, making it difficult terrain for hostile creatures while the trap is active.

text: The shaitan observes the area from a distance, observing the battlefield as a game board. The ground trembles in response to the genie's enthusiasm.
